LightningComponentBundle.description: Persistent global footer with sibling-portal and legal links (including Do Not Sell My Information) for the Sinclair Brand Portal chrome. Rendered once into the site theme layout footer region.

property.name: legalLinksJson
property.label: Legal Links (JSON)
property.description: Optional JSON array of {label, url} for legal links. Leave empty to use Privacy Policy, Terms of Use and Do Not Sell My Information.

property.name: siblingLinksJson
property.label: Sibling Portal Links (JSON)
property.description: Optional JSON array of {label, url} for sibling-portal links. Leave empty to ship legal links only until the exact links are supplied.
